title: CallAction
description: A one-tap backend operation: the client asks `confirm` first when present, calls `function` with `params` (adding `p_locale`), then applies `on_success` (specs/COMMUNITY.md 3.2). The backend re-checks permission on every call.

function.description: The backend function to call, a name from contract/names.json.

params.description: The function's named arguments, sent as given with `p_locale` added.

confirm.description: The backend's wording for a confirmation shown before calling. Absent: call at once.

on_success.description: What the client does after the call succeeds: refresh the screen, dismiss it (guide 5.3 rule 9), or nothing.

role.description: A meaning each platform styles its own way.
